definition.request_raw_loss: C_mq = arithmetic mean of the saved daily empirical CRPS losses over the request's native leads 1..H
definition.training_portfolio_return: r_t = log1p(sum_a w_a * expm1(x_ta)), using the exact frozen AssetInputs.training constituent interval rows, weights and operation order
definition.training_sample_sd: sigma_q = sqrt(sum_t((r_t - mean(r))^2)/(n-1)); training rows are the exact causal prefix through and including the origin observation
definition.requested_horizon: H is the exact positive integer native requested horizon for that scored request; no 252-day conversion or bucket-derived substitute
definition.outer_aggregation: Unchanged V9 fixed planned request weights within each of the three actual-date calendar buckets, then equal one-third mean of short, medium and long bucket Q values exactly once

calendar_buckets.short: requested end date <= origin plus 3 calendar years
calendar_buckets.medium: origin plus 3 calendar years < requested end date < origin plus 20 calendar years
calendar_buckets.long: requested end date >= origin plus 20 calendar years

definition.fixed_hierarchy: Within each bucket, use the full planned schedule's frozen asset/portfolio branch, class, family, series and within-series planned-request weights from V9; no quarter weights and no outcome-dependent reweighting
definition.primary_quantity: Q_m = sum_q omega_q * Z_mq; lower is better
definition.baseline_display: After aggregation only, report 100 * (1 - Q_model/Q_WR) against the same fixed matched WR; this is a descriptive ratio, not the primary proper loss
definition.domain_policy: No epsilon, floor, clipping, exclusions or fallback. Every training SD and sigma*sqrt(H) must be positive and finite. The bound score-blind audit found 0 zero/constant prefixes and 0 nonfinite scales across all 320017 planned requests.
definition.coverage_policy: Require the full predeclared planned support and exact matched request identities for a final result; do not impute missing requests.
definition.historical_policy: V9 raw-CRPS and V10 win-rate outputs remain immutable historical/diagnostic results; V11 is a new definition and must be rescored from saved raw per-request mean CRPS.

planned_support.horizon_bucket_assignment: Frozen V8 actual-date mapping; H itself is retained independently as requested native horizon.
